vectors.name: anim-img2webp-lossless
commands: img2webp -loop 0 -d 50 sprite-flat-48x32-1.png -d 100 sprite-flat-48x32-2.png sprite-flat-48x32-3.png -d 150 sprite-flat-48x32-4.png -o anim-img2webp-lossless.webp

vectors.name: anim-img2webp-mixed
commands: img2webp -mixed -loop 3 -kmin 1 -kmax 2 -d 70 sprite-photo-48x32-1.png sprite-photo-48x32-2.png sprite-photo-48x32-3.png sprite-photo-48x32-4.png -o anim-img2webp-mixed.webp

vectors.name: anim-webpmux
commands: webpmux -frame anim-webpmux-f1.webp +80+0+0+0-b -frame anim-webpmux-f2.webp +60+10+8+1+b -frame anim-webpmux-f3.webp +100+30+14+0-b -frame anim-webpmux-f4.webp +40+2+18+1+b -loop 4 -bgcolor 255,40,80,120 -o anim-webpmux.webp

vectors.name: meta-anim-exif-o6
commands: img2webp -loop 0 -d 50 sprite-flat-48x32-1.png -d 100 sprite-flat-48x32-2.png sprite-flat-48x32-3.png -d 150 sprite-flat-48x32-4.png -o meta-anim-exif-o6-0.webp

vectors.name: meta-anim-icc-xmp
commands: webpmux -frame meta-anim-icc-xmp-0-f1.webp +80+0+0+0-b -frame meta-anim-icc-xmp-0-f2.webp +60+10+8+1+b -frame meta-anim-icc-xmp-0-f3.webp +100+30+14+0-b -frame meta-anim-icc-xmp-0-f4.webp +40+2+18+1+b -loop 4 -bgcolor 255,40,80,120 -o meta-anim-icc-xmp-0.webp
